deliberation: The successor correctly separates substantive Human Steward authorization, routine review routing, pre-merge qualification, and post-merge observation. GI-STEWARD-0002 already fixes the human primitive at one authenticated exact-packet authorization by the ordinary Human Steward and assigns jimsteeg only a recovery role; a routine request for jimsteeg is invalid routing, not an additional safety gate. Expensive replay is evidence generation and may be selected by a closed dependency classifier without changing office powers, provided unknown or mixed effects fail closed.
discharged_obligations: Separated authorization, platform routing, qualification, readback, and recovery into non-interchangeable primitives.
Checked that removal of routine jimsteeg routing enforces current authority rather than creating a delegation.
Defined the minimum authority boundary for impact-gated evidence execution.
findings: GI-STEWARD-0002 makes fyremael the ordinary Human Steward and jimsteeg the recovery owner, with no mandatory routine reviewer.
A GitHub review request or approval state is not constitutional authorization.
Post-merge suites generate evidence but cannot create institutional effect.
A lightweight exact-SHA readback is distinct from a new Council campaign.
conditions: Define routine request, recovery operation, known dependency class, unknown or mixed state, expensive suite, and exact-SHA readback normatively.
Unknown, mixed, renamed, generated, or transitively affected paths must select conservative fanout.
Readback success may record integration facts only and cannot approve, activate, ratify, certify, or promote.
residual_uncertainty: The complete cross-repository dependency map is not yet enumerated.
The exact boundary between lightweight readback and suite replay requires executable contracts.
